install_tell: docker run -p 8081:8081 confluentinc/cp-schema-registry:latest — no auth block by default
misconfig_patterns: GET /subjects unauthenticated returns full subject catalog
PUT /config unauthenticated changes global compatibility level

response_markers: bare JSON array of subject-name strings
active_probe.false_positive_check: response must be a top-level JSON array (not object/HTML) with Content-Type vnd.schemaregistry — disambiguates from Flink Dashboard and Druid Coordinator which also use 8081

deployment_tells: port 8081 open, JSON-only responses, no HTML shell
collides with Flink Dashboard JobManager REST and Druid Coordinator on same port
pivot_paths: GET /subjects -> full schema catalog (data model, PII field names, business object shapes)
if write also unauth: POST new schema version -> downstream-consumer poisoning
